plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Grandstream UCM IP-PBX (GS-SoftWareUCM-SNMP-MIB). It reports uptime, CPU load average, memory utilization, concurrent calls, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 12581).
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: device_cpu_load1
metrics.description: 1-minute CPU load average of the Grandstream UCM (GS-SoftWareUCM-SNMP-MIB sCpuUsage, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.12581.2.2.8.0). The device returns load-average text; the first number is used. A value persistently above the CPU core count indicates the PBX is overloaded.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load5
metrics.description: 5-minute CPU load average of the Grandstream UCM, the second number of the sCpuUsage load-average text when the device reports three values.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load15
metrics.description: 15-minute CPU load average of the Grandstream UCM, the third number of the sCpuUsage load-average text when the device reports three values.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Grandstream UCM, reported only when the sCpuUsage text carries a percent sign (for example "12%"); load-average text is reported as CPU load instead.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Grandstream UCM (GS-SoftWareUCM-SNMP-MIB sMemoryUsage, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.12581.2.2.7.0). Percentage text such as "45%" is used directly; "used/total" text is divided at collection.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Grandstream UCM in bytes, reported when sMemoryUsage is "used/total" text with size units (for example "460M/1024M").

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Grandstream UCM in bytes, reported when sMemoryUsage is "used/total" text with size units.

metrics.name: concurrent_calls
metrics.description: Number of calls currently in progress on the Grandstream UCM (GS-SoftWareUCM-SNMP-MIB concurrentCall, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.12581.2.2.9.0).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
